title: Configure restricted numeric calculated columns in shared report engine
description: Customer builds reusable row-level numeric columns using a structured arithmetic AST with authorized numeric field references, numeric literals and + - * / only; no raw expressions, eval, scripts or SQL. At most 8 computed columns, 64 AST nodes per column, depth 8, absolute literal <=1e12, whole definition <=64KiB; unique keys cannot collide with base fields; computed-to-computed references are rejected. Unknown/hidden/unauthorized/non-numeric inputs are rejected before source read. Dependencies are rechecked under fresh recipient scope and fetched through provider authorization even when omitted from display; return only selected base/computed columns, never hidden dependency values. Checked decimal arithmetic: missing/null inputs, zero divisor and overflow produce null with explicit bounded reason, never silent zero. Addition/subtraction require compatible units and currency semantics; multiplication/division permit dimensionless constants; compatible same-unit ratio is dimensionless. Reject combinations whose currency/unit compatibility cannot be proven. Evaluate only current preview rows before generic rendering; no computed filtering/grouping/aggregation/all-match totals. Advertise only this restricted capability, keep arbitrary formulas/pivot/joins unsupported. JSON persisted drafts and pinned revisions preserve definitions, backward-compatible existing definitions without computed columns. Add structured field/operator/number editor and visible per-column unit/unknown reasons. Generic Excel/PDF inherit outputs and evidence, no dataset-specific exporters. Stage 1 unified platform only; existing sales-order/receivable adapters are engine fixtures, not migration or new bespoke reports. Preserve old report entries until every fixed/dynamic report passes Stage 2 parity. No Agent or cross-business flow work. Server-authenticated identity and fresh existing menu/field/row/data scope remain authoritative, saved definitions/grants never grant ERP permissions. No arbitrary SQL, scripts, joins, tables, mixed currency/unit totals or one-to-many header duplication. No migrations, SchemaUpgrader/SeedData modifications, production SQL/database execution, schema/view/procedure changes, secrets/.env/config changes, deployment or irreversible operations. Use existing HTTP and entity audit conventions. Safe build/test and relevant offline integration tests required; missing actual DB/browser/font environment must be explicitly blocked, never claim the phase complete from build. Preserve unrelated source/work.
acceptance_criteria: Bounded structured formula validation rejects unsupported operations, unauthorized inputs and incompatible units/currencies before queries while older definitions still load.
Fresh preview/shared execution resolves authorized dependencies and projects only selected calculated outputs with checked decimal/null reasons; grouping/filtering over formulas stays unsupported.
Structured UI builder, saved/pinned formulas and generic Excel/PDF agree on selected values/unit/unknown evidence; meaningful offline formula/export/UI tests pass safe build/test.
